question: Is Alpha from CP8 a relative of Kalifa? Also, CP9 is a secret organization, but is CP0 secret?
answer: Alpha is Kalifa's younger sister. 22 years ago, CP9 included Laskey, their father. Cipher Pol typically trains orphaned children to become intelligence agents, so this is a rare case. Having said that, they were raised individually, with basically no family ties. In the world of spycraft, love and emotions are an exploitable weakness!
name: Haruhime
